More Information On Sally Baxter, MD, MSc
sources.text: The Baxter Lab We perform innovative and cross-disciplinary research in ophthalmology and informatics to develop and leverage advances in health information technology for improving vision and health. Our research encompasses several areas of ophthalmology and informatics. Here are some of the research topics our lab has engaged in. Health Information Technology Integration Manual time-motion observations Analyses of electronic health record (EHR) audit log data Use and integration of remote sensing devices Big Data & Artificial Intelligence (AI) Predictive modeling / machine learning Natural language processing Implementation of AI models into clinical practice Translational Research Working with basic scientists to explore the viability of experimental results by analyzing clinical data More Information On Sally Baxter, MD, MSc UCSD Academic Profile, visit: https://profiles.ucsd.edu/sally.baxter Clinical Profile, visit: https://shileyeye.ucsd.edu/faculty/sallylbaxter Donations If you would like to donate, you can do so by visiting the UCSD Giving page and entering “E7682” in the “Enter keyword or fund number” field at the top. Support for research associated with the Ophthalmology Informatics and Data Science area of specialty in the Viterbi Family Department of Ophthalmology and the Shiley Eye Institute at UC San Diego under the direction of Dr. Sally Baxter.
